summary: Hadiya app fresh implementation tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (root, daily-reminder, hijri-date, emotions list+ayah w/ Claude Sonnet 4.5 reflection, user CRUD+persistence, azkar list+progress roundtrip, saved-ayahs roundtrip, dawah preview, SMS endpoint). Frontend: splash, onboarding, home (Hijri + live prayer countdown), feelings sheet with LLM-personalized reflection ('Yusuf, anxiety tightens the chest...'), save/share buttons, tasbeeh count+reset, azkar 5 sections render, settings sheet prefilled with user data + SMS controls — all verified visually with screenshots.

minor.issue: Returns 500 with raw Twilio exception in detail when destination phone is unverified on trial account. Behaviour is expected (graceful, not a crash) per task spec, but frontend should ideally surface a user-friendly message rather than the raw error string.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping a section header to expand did not render the items list in automated tests (sections={5} but items={0} after click via mouse.click/dispatch_event). Other TouchableOpacity components (emotion tiles, tasbeeh tap-zone) responded fine to the same click strategy, so this may be a real onPress wiring issue on the section header — recommend manual verification in browser.

Tapping 'Send me a piece of dawah now' yields no visible toast/alert/feedback on web — backend returns 500 (expected for unverified Twilio trial) but UI gives no confirmation either way. Add a success/error toast.

issues: Invalid DOM property `transform-origin` (should be `transformOrigin`) — RN-web style key mismatch in some component (likely a Reanimated/Animated style).
Deprecation: `TouchableWithoutFeedback is deprecated. Please use Pressable.`
Deprecation: `Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode` (in splash assets).

react_native_issues.issue: Several Expo packages off-version (warning on Expo start): @react-native-async-storage/async-storage 3.0.2 vs expected 2.2.0, expo-haptics 55.0.14 vs ~15.0.8, expo-keep-awake 55.0.8 vs ~15.0.8, expo-location 55.1.10 vs ~19.0.8, react-native-svg 15.15.5 vs 15.12.1. App still runs but may cause subtle native build issues.

action_items: Investigate AzkarSheet section expand: confirm onPress fires and items render in browser; if it works manually, this is just a Playwright/RN-web quirk and can be ignored.
Add user feedback (toast or Alert) for 'Send me a piece of dawah now' result (success sid OR error).
Optional: Fix the `transform-origin` style key → `transformOrigin` to silence the React DOM warning.
Optional: Replace deprecated `TouchableWithoutFeedback`/`pointerEvents` prop usages and `style.resizeMode` on Image.
Optional: Run `npx expo install --check --fix` to align package versions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/sms/send leaks raw exception text in `detail=f'SMS send failed: {e}'` — recommend a sanitized message; do log full e on server side only.
server.py uses synchronous `requests.get(...)` inside async route `/api/hijri-date` (blocking the event loop). Switch to httpx.AsyncClient.
Pydantic v2: `payload.dict()` (in update_user) is deprecated; use `payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True)`.
server.py is ~385 lines, still under threshold but growing — consider splitting routes into modules (users, azkar, emotions, sms) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed users via /api/users during pytest run; one saved ayah with reference '1:1' for the test user. Also one real user 'Yusuf' / '+15551234567' created via onboarding UI for manual flow verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: https://dark-dhikr.preview.emergentagent.com. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env (note: NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL, that key doesn't exist here). For UI testing of bottom sheets, use element.dispatch_event('click') or element.scroll_into_view_if_needed() then page.mouse.click — direct page.click can fail with 'outside viewport' since sheet content extends below the 844px mobile viewport. AsyncStorage in Expo web uses localStorage with prefixed keys; clearing localStorage forces onboarding. AzkarSheet section expand needs manual verification.
rca_of_issue: SMS 500 is by design (Twilio trial cannot deliver to unverified numbers — Twilio raises HTTP 21608). Backend correctly catches and re-raises as HTTPException(500). No fix required on backend; UX layer should add a toast. Settings 'empty fields' seen in an earlier test was caused by hard-navigating to /home via page.goto (which detaches AsyncStorage state in dev/web in some scenarios); when settings is opened naturally after onboarding without hard reload, fields prefill correctly with Yusuf / +15551234567.
